findings.title: Fail missing configured thermal evidence
findings.why_it_matters: A manifest that explicitly names a thermal-evidence directory but whose directory was deleted is treated as an indeterminate coverage gap instead of a failed thermal replay. That makes a bad configured artifact indistinguishable at the numerical-rule status level from an older manifest that intentionally supplied no evidence, despite the public function contract saying supplied unreplayable evidence fails closed. Return a failing finding for the `Some(root) if !root.is_dir()` case so configured paths remain an integrity boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `Finding::indeterminate` with `Finding::fail` in the supplied-but-not-directory match arm, and add a test that `run(Some(missing_path), ...)` gives the numerical rule `Status::Fail` while `run(None, ...)` remains indeterminate.
evidence:
zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/bridge_thermal.rs:20-21 -- /// branch model. Missing evidence is indeterminate; supplied evidence that
/// cannot be replayed or bound fails closed.
zapote/packages/zapote-core/src/lib.rs:827-834 -- a CheckReport containing a Fail finding is Fail, whereas one containing only an Indeterminate finding is Indeterminate.
